title: Notification SLA compliance — regulator coverage (ransomware)
summary: Share of confirmed-ransomware events whose regulator early-warning notification was drafted and dispatched within the statutory window (NIS2 Article 23 — 24-hour early warning; DORA Article 19 — 4-hour initial report after classification as major). The ransomware-containment playbook's comms-plan step stages the notification for human sign-off; this KPI counts whether that staging-and-dispatch loop closes inside the regulatory clock. Higher is better.

target.rationale: Statutory windows admit no partial-credit miss.

measurement.formula: count(comms_plan.notification.dispatched_at <= statutory_deadline(incident.classified_at)) / count(confirmed ransomware events requiring notification) over window.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: confirmed ransomware events reaching the comms-plan step

inputs.name: on_time
inputs.description: notifications whose dispatch timestamp is within the statutory window

external_refs.name: NIS2 Directive (EU) 2022/2555, Article 23 — incident reporting obligations
DORA Regulation (EU) 2022/2554, Article 19 — reporting of major ICT-related incidents
